open_issues.description: Native production model creation has no explicit output-token cap configuration path. Token-enabled reservations therefore stop its uncapped requests before dispatch.

open_issues.description: API price recalculation can add cost on unchanged replay, while missing prices pass a positive dollar guard as zero.
open_issues.resolution: Strict captured API estimates persist through response, replay and child recovery. Explicit unpriced rates reject new dollar-enabled sends; old-writer inconsistent costs fail transactionally.

open_issues.description: Recorded dollar guards do not reserve concurrent planned costs; rates and dollar caps are not run-wide pinned. Two actual-SDK mock calls record1.00USD against0.75USD while recorded price coverage is complete.
open_issues.resolution: Define explicit run-wide rate/cap and uncertainty policy, then validate both token and dollar capacity before any hold write. Price-gap admission is now resolved separately; full monetary admission remains open.
